title: Once the unpaid-gym lock is on, a read-only gym can still send members messages and change reminders and timings
what: The banner for a gym that stopped paying says nothing can be changed or added (read-only) or that only check-in, fees and the member list work (basic). The server only blocks member records, shop, challenges, offers, diet and body records and branding. Sending a message or offer to members, saving the automatic reminders and saving the gym timings have no check of the gym's state, and the server notes say closing messages was left for 'a later step' that never came. So an unpaid gym keeps messaging members while the screen says it cannot.
expected: In basic and read-only, the owner's own message sends and settings saves are refused the same way as other changes (automatic reward messages can stay), and the banner's words match what is really blocked.
who: gyms that stop paying, once the lock is switched on
how_often: every message or settings save while lapsed
fix_line: Add the same state check to message sends and the reminders and timings saves before the lock goes on

title: A GST-registered gym cannot see how much GST it collected in a month
what: When the gym saves its GSTIN, each printed receipt splits the tax out of the amount paid. That split exists only on the receipt. The collections report, the growth report and the data download show only the full amounts, with no tax column and no monthly GST total, so an owner filing GST must open every receipt or work it out by hand (and the rate changed from 18 to 5 percent on 22 Sep 2025).
expected: With a GSTIN saved, the collections report and its download show the GST inside the money taken for the chosen period, worked out at the rate of each payment's date.
fix_line: Show a GST column and period total in collections and its download when a GSTIN is saved

title: Days the gym is closed still count as days a member stayed away
what: The owner can mark special closed days (a festival, repairs) in Gym timings. The Away list counts plain calendar days since the last visit, and nothing in it or in the 'we haven't seen you' reminder looks at the gym's closed days. After a closure of a week, regular members are flagged as slipping away and can be sent 'we miss you' for days the gym itself was shut.
expected: Days the gym was closed are left out when counting how long a member has been away.
who: gyms that close for some days
how_often: after every closure longer than a few days
fix_line: Skip the saved closed days when counting days away, on the panel and the phone
